Method of Attack: Bypass System Integrity Protection (SIP) to perform arbitrary operations, elevate privileges to root, and install rootkits
Bypass Transparency, Consent, and Control (TCC) technology to access users' protected data
Circumvent Apple's File Quarantine, Gatekeeper, and Notarization security checks to download more malware and run unsigned payloads
Attack Vector: Exploitation of macOS security flaws to bypass protections like SIP, TCC, File Quarantine, Gatekeeper, and Notarization
